name: Santa's House at Mittineague Park
when_note: Santa arrives by fire truck on Sunday, December 13 at 2 pm. After that he visits on weekends from 2:30 to 4 pm and 5:30 to 7:30 pm, and on weekdays from 5:30 to 7:30 pm, through December 23.
host: West Springfield Park and Recreation Department
paras: The West Springfield Park and Recreation Department has run Santa's House at Mittineague Park since 1980. Santa arrives by fire truck on Sunday, December 13, 2026, at 2 pm, then meets children each day through December 23.

The town lists no admission fee and asks only for donations, which go to Operation Santa for local families in need. Kids can drop a letter in Santa's mailbox, and families should bring their own cameras for photos.
tip: Weekday visits run only from 5:30 to 7:30 pm, so weekends give the most choice of times.
